conservative_label_box_model: 20px height;10px per nonspace,4px per space plus8px halo at11px font. All pairs separated,all boxes outside nodes and inside expanded canvas.
leader_attachment_checks: Every displaced-by-at-least20px label has a non-arrow leader under its own original edge/evidence anchor; independently recomputed attachment point lies on its arrow path.
limits: No browser/interactivity test; static SVG semantics, geometry and raster inspection only.
Edge and leader line crossings remain permitted; the fix prevents predicate label box overlap, not all line crossing.

visual_review.method: Original generated SVG with repository stylesheet and inherited light palette rendered by rsvg-convert at1866px; visually inspected.
visual_review.observation: Previously overlapping consumes/regulates labels are individually readable, node labels fit, and non-arrow leaders retain label-to-edge association.

disposition.remaining_release_steps: Root-owned final gates, commit/head bridge, CI and merge.
